question: According to the 2011 Census of India, among the State/ UTs, the male and female literacy rate is highest in ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**kerala**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Literacy level and educational attainment are vital developmental indicators in a developing nation like India as they are key variables of measure of development as they indicate the quality of life, awareness level, and also the level of skill of people in the society.
 
• The female literacy rate of India as per the 2011 census is 65.5%. 
 
• The literacy rate at all Indian levels is 74% and the male literacy rate is 82.1%.
 
• In 2011, among the State/ UTs, the male and female literacy rate is highest in Kerala (male: 96.1%, female 92.1%) and lowest in Bihar (male: 71.2%, female: 51.5%).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Census of India 2011:

 
• The 2011 census is the country's 15th national census and the 7th census after independence.
 
• The Census of the year 2011 was released on March 31, 2011, by the Union Home Secretary and R.G.I. of India.
 
• The slogan of Census 2011 was 'Our Census, Our Future'.
 
• Registrar General and Census Commissioner under whom Census 2011 was conducted - C. Chandra Mouli.
 
• It was conducted in two phases, house listing, and population enumeration.
 
• The Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) was conducted in 2011 for the first time since 1931.
